sn4.22:1.1: Ekaṃ samayam Bhagavā Sakkesu viharati Silāvatiyaṃ || || 2.
sn4.22:1.2: Tena kho pana samayena āyasmā Samiddhi. Bhagavato avidūre appamatto ātāpī pahitatto viharati || || 3.
sn4.22:1.3: Atha kho āyasmato Samiddhissa rahogatassa paṭisallīnassa evaṃ cetaso parivitakko udapādi || ||
sn4.22:1.4: Lābhā vata me suladdhaṃ vata me
sn4.22:1.6: Lābhā vata me suladdhaṃ vata me
sn4.22:1.8: Lābhā vata me suladdhaṃ vata me
sn4.22:1.9: yassa me sabrahmacāriyo sīlavanto kalyāṇa-dhammo ti || || 4.
sn4.22:1.10: Atha kho Māro pāpimā āyasmato Samiddhissa cetaso cetoparivitakkam aññāya || yenāyasmā Samiddhi ten-upasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā āyasmato Samiddhissa avidūre mahantaṃ bhayabheravaṃ saddam akāsi || Apissudaṃ pathavī maññe udrīyatīti || || 5.
sn4.22:2.1: Atha kho āyasmā Samiddhi yena Bhagavā ten-upasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantam abhivādetvā ekam antaṃ nisīdi || ekam antaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā Samiddhi Bhagavantam etad avoca || || 6.
sn4.22:2.2: Idhāhaṃ bhante Bhagavato avidūre appamatto ātāpī pahitatto viharāmi ||
sn4.22:2.3: tassa mayham bhante rahogatassa paṭisallīnassa evaṃ cetaso parivitakko udapādi || ||
sn4.22:2.4: Lābhā vata me suladdhaṃ vata me
sn4.22:2.6: Lābhā vata me suladdhaṃ vata me
sn4.22:2.8: Lābhā vata me suladdhaṃ vata me
sn4.22:2.9: yassa me sabrahmacāriyo sīlavanto kalyāṇadhammo ti || ||
sn4.22:2.10: Tassa mayhaṃ bhante avidūre mahā bhayabheravasaddo ahosi || apissudaṃ pathavī maññe udrīyatīti || || 7.
sn4.22:3.2: Māro eso pāpimā tuyhaṃ vicakkhukammāya āgato ||
sn4.22:3.3: gaccha tvaṃ Samiddhi tatth-eva appamatto ātāpī pahitatto viharāhīti || || 8.
sn4.22:3.4: Evaṃ bhante ti kho āyasmā Samiddhi Bhagavato paṭi- suṇitvā uṭṭhāyāsanā Bhagavantam abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkāmi || || 9.
sn4.22:3.5: Dutiyam pi kho āyasmā Samiddhi tatth-eva appamatto ātāpī pahitatto vihāsi || ||
sn4.22:3.6: Dutiyam pi kho āyasmato Samiddhissa rahogatassa paṭisallīnassa evaṃ cetaso parivitakko udapādi || Lābhā vata me suladdhaṃ vata me yassa me satthā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho || pe ||
sn4.22:3.7: kalyāṇadhammo ti || || Dutiyam pi kho Māro pāpimā āyasmato Samiddhissa cetasā ceto parivitakkam aññaya || pa ||
sn4.22:3.9: Atha kho āyasmā Samiddhi || Māro ayam pāpimā iti viditvā Māraṃ pāpimantaṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsi || ||
sn4.22:5.1: Atha kho Māro pāpimā jānāti maṃ Samiddhi bhikkhūti dukkhī dummano tatth-ev-antaradhāyīti || || 1.
